items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Applications / Utilities

*   [zerx-lab/FluxDown (⭐1k)](https://github.com/zerx-lab/FluxDown) - A multi-protocol download manager with a Rust/Tokio engine, supporting HTTP/FTP, BitTorrent, eD2K, HLS and DASH, with IDM-style dynamic segmentation, browser extensions and an aria2-compatible JSON-RPC endpoint.

### Libraries / Parsing

*   [ophi-dev/antlr-rust-runtime (⭐10)](https://github.com/ophi-dev/antlr-rust-runtime) \[[antlr-rust-runtime](https://crates.io/crates/antlr-rust-runtime)] - ANTLR v4 runtime with a pure-Rust parser generator: generates parsers directly from `.g4` grammars (no Java required), validated against the official ANTLR conformance testsuite. [![build badge](https://github.com/ophi-dev/antlr-rust-runtime/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/ophi-dev/antlr-rust-runtime/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
